summary: Completed comprehensive testing of WhatsApp Sandwich Bot User Management System. Backend: 22/22 tests passed. Frontend: Admin panel correctly displays Users, Sessions, and Reminders sections.
critical_code_review_comments: User creation (CREAR ADMIN/DELIVERY username password) working correctly - only master admin can create users
Login system (soy username clave password) working - creates session for phone number
Logout (cerrar sesion) working - closes session for phone number
Kick users (KICKEAR username) working - master admin can close any user's session
Delete users (ELIMINAR username) working - removes user and all their sessions
List users (USUARIOS) working - shows all registered users and active sessions
GET /api/sandwich/users endpoint returns user list correctly
GET /api/sandwich/sessions endpoint returns admin_sessions and delivery_sessions correctly
POST /api/sandwich/send-reminders endpoint triggers reminder system correctly
Delivery can use LISTO X, ENCAMINO X, ENTREGADO X commands when logged in
Frontend AdminSandwich.jsx displays 'Usuarios del Bot' and 'Sesiones Activas' sections
Reminder system documented in UI - 5 min intervals for unconfirmed orders
seed_data_creation: Test config set: admin_phone=1111111111 for master admin testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: User management system fully tested: 1) CREAR ADMIN/DELIVERY username password - creates users (master admin only), 2) soy username clave password - login from any phone, 3) cerrar sesion - logout, 4) KICKEAR username - close user's session, 5) ELIMINAR username - delete user, 6) USUARIOS - list all users and sessions. Endpoints tested: GET /api/sandwich/users, GET /api/sandwich/sessions, POST /api/sandwich/send-reminders. Frontend displays users and sessions in WhatsApp Bot tab. WhatsApp service (localhost:3003) not connected - only backend logic tested via /api/sandwich/whatsapp/message endpoint.
